## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, with a regression test for every fixed bug
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) for changes to the library
- [ ] Public API changes: TSDoc updated, `pnpm docs:check` passes and the docs updated
- [ ] New behavior is opt-in, or the breaking change is called out
- [ ] Any third-party material has a compatible license and is listed in `NOTICE`
